svg.title: My language solar system
svg.desc: Solar system of languages: 8 languages as planets, 2 recently pushed repos as comets, 0 archived repos as an asteroid belt.
svg.text: Each planet is a language: the bigger the planet, the more code I wrote in it.
Small moons count the repos using that language, and comets are repos I
pushed to in the last 14 days.
Planets are my languages, comets are my latest pushes.
